# Alert Logic & Price Data Checklist: USDT Price Alerts

**Purpose**: Review the quality of the requirements for reading the Wallex price and for alert
crossing, re-arming and notification, before implementation starts
**Created**: 2026-10-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [data-model.md](../data-model.md) ·
[contracts/wallex-source.md](../contracts/wallex-source.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Depth: Standard · Audience: reviewer, before implementation

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Does the spec state whether alerts are evaluated when the latest price is stale (no successful read for more than 5 minutes), or only that failed reads are skipped? [Gap, Spec §FR-003, §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK002 Is it specified whether an alert may fire on a last traded price whose trade is hours old, given the plan observed trades about 11 hours old? [Gap, Spec §FR-011, research.md R1]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the "last trade at" time required by the spec, or does it appear only in the plan and contracts? [Gap, Spec §FR-003, contracts/http-routes.md]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for what happens to an alert's state when its threshold or direction is edited while it is triggered? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK005 Is it specified whether resuming a paused alert whose condition is already true fires on the next price check? [Gap, Spec §FR-009, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK006 Does the spec define what happens to notification history when the alert that produced it is deleted? [Gap, Spec §FR-009, §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK007 Are requirements defined for several alerts of the same user firing on the same price reading (one notification each, or grouped)? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the state of a user's alerts specified after the user is deactivated and later reactivated? [Gap, Spec §FR-017, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK009 Are the required contents of a notification in the list complete, e.g. whether the alert's note and direction are included? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK010 Does the spec require any wording in notifications or on alert pages that signals are informational and not financial advice? [Gap, Spec §FR-016]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK011 Is "active alert" in the 20-alert limit defined in terms of the alert states (armed, triggered, paused)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-015, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "the other side of the threshold" for re-arming defined as strictly below/above X, consistent with "at or beyond" for firing? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the rounding rule for Wallex prices that carry decimals specified in the requirements, given thresholds are whole Toman? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, research.md R5]
- [ ] CHK014 Is "invalid data" in FR-004 defined with concrete conditions (non-numeric, zero or negative price, missing or future timestamp)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK015 Is "a recent history" of prices given a concrete length and a stated purpose (who uses it)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the relationship between direction (above/below) and signal (buy/sell) explained so users understand that any combination is allowed? [Clarity, Spec User Story 3, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK017 Is what admins may do when they "manage" alerts and notifications specified (view only, edit, delete, pause)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-018]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK018 Is the 5-minute stale threshold consistent with the 1-minute read interval and SC-001, and is the reason for the gap stated? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, §FR-003, §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the term "price" used with the single meaning "last traded price" across user stories, requirements and success criteria? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, User Story 1]
- [ ] CHK020 Do the alert states named in the spec's Key Entities ("active, paused, triggered-waiting-to-re-arm") match the states in the data model ("armed, triggered, paused")? [Consistency, Spec Key Entities, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK021 Is "delivery status" of a Notification in the spec consistent with in-site-only delivery, where nothing is sent? [Conflict, Spec Key Entities, §FR-013]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK022 Can SC-001 be measured objectively, given it states a price difference in terms of a time interval? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK023 Does SC-002 define where the 2-minute timing starts (the trade on Wallex, or the first reading that shows the crossing)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK024 Does SC-003 ("zero duplicate notifications") define what counts as a single crossing and over which observation period? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK025 Do the acceptance scenarios of User Story 3 cover both directions for re-arming, not only for firing? [Coverage, Spec User Story 3]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK026 Are recovery requirements defined for crossings that happen while price reading is down (e.g. the price crosses X and comes back before reading resumes)? [Gap, Recovery]
- [ ] CHK027 Are requirements defined for a user editing or deleting an alert at the same moment it is being evaluated? [Gap, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK028 Are rate limiting and back-off behavior toward Wallex specified as requirements, or only in the plan? [Gap, Spec §FR-001, research.md R2]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the price hovering exactly at X (price equal to X on many readings) addressed by the re-arm rule without extra notifications? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases, §FR-012]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK030 Are requirements defined for alerting admins (not only showing status) when price reading has failed for a sustained period? [Gap, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK031 Is a maximum time to evaluate all active alerts after a reading specified, given up to 20 alerts per user? [Gap, Spec §FR-010, plan.md Performance Goals]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK032 Is the assumption that Wallex's public data is reachable from the production server's location validated or recorded as a risk? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK033 Is it documented whether Wallex's terms allow automated polling of its public API? [Assumption, Dependency]
- [ ] CHK034 Are requirements defined for detecting a change in Wallex's response format, given its documentation could not be read and the format is based on observed responses? [Dependency, contracts/wallex-source.md]
